words.definition: adj. 空白的；茫然的 n. 空白（处） v.（因震惊）一片空白

examples.en: Write your name in the blank space at the top.
examples.zh: 把名字写在顶端的空白处。

examples.en: Her mind went completely blank during the interview.
examples.zh: 面试时她大脑一片空白。

words.usage: blank cheque（空白支票；全权授权）、blank expression（茫然的表情）高频；draw a blank（落空；想不起来）；blanket（毯子）同源。
collocations: mind goes blank 大脑一片空白

words.definition: n. 画廊，美术馆；楼座；长廊

examples.en: We spent the afternoon at the National Gallery.
examples.zh: 我们下午在国家美术馆度过。

examples.en: His photos will be shown in a small gallery downtown.
examples.zh: 他的照片将在市中心一家小画廊展出。

words.usage: art gallery（美术馆）高频；press gallery（记者席）；play to the gallery（迎合低级趣味）习语；复数 galleries。

confusables.note: galley 单桅帆船·厨房，双 l 异义
与 ballerina 芭蕾演员区分

collocations: play to the gallery 迎合大众

words.definition: v. 渗透，弥漫，散布

examples.en: The smell of freshly ground coffee permeated the office.
examples.zh: 现磨咖啡的香味弥漫整个办公室。

examples.en: Distrust has permeated every level of the organization.
examples.zh: 不信任情绪已渗透到组织的各个层级。

words.usage: permeate through/into（渗透进）；名词 permeation；形容词 permeable（可渗透的，semi-permeable membrane 半透膜）；与 penetrate（穿透）之别：permeate 弥漫渗入各处。
collocations: permeate the air 弥漫在空气中
words.mnemonic: per(全)+meate(走)→ 走遍各处 → 弥漫

words.definition: n./v. 否决，否决权

examples.en: The president vetoed the bill last week.
examples.zh: 总统上周否决了该法案。

examples.en: Each member has the right of veto.
examples.zh: 每个成员都拥有否决权。

words.usage: veto a bill/plan（否决议案/计划）；veto power（否决权）；拉丁语「我禁止」；复数 vetoes；与 vote（投票）形近义远。

confusables.note: vet 兽医；审查，-et 形近

collocations: veto a bill 否决议案

words.definition: n. 授权令；正当理由 v. 保证；使有必要

examples.en: Police executed a search warrant at dawn.
examples.zh: 警方拂晓执行了搜查令。

examples.en: The situation warrants a careful response.
examples.zh: 这种情况需要谨慎应对。

words.usage: search/arrest warrant（搜查令/逮捕令）法律高频；warrant doing（使…成为必要）；warranty 保修单同源；unwarranted（无根据的）反义派生。
words.mnemonic: warrant 发令 → 授权令；保证

words.definition: v. 猛推，挤 n. 猛推

examples.en: People shoved to get onto the crowded train.
examples.zh: 人们推搡着挤上拥挤的火车。

examples.en: He shoved the papers into his drawer.
examples.zh: 他把文件胡乱塞进抽屉。

words.usage: shove past/through（挤过去）；shove sth aside（推开）；当 push 的粗鲁版；习语 when push comes to shove（到了紧要关头）高频。
collocations: when push comes to shove 紧要关头
words.mnemonic: sh-ove 用力一操 → 猛推

words.definition: v. 使受伤，伤害（身体；名誉）

examples.en: Three people were injured in the crash.
examples.zh: 三人在车祸中受伤。

examples.en: The remark injured her deeply.
examples.zh: 这话深深地伤害了她。

words.usage: be injured in（在…中受伤）；badly/seriously injured（重伤）；injury n. 伤（injuries）；与 wound（刀枪伤）、hurt（疼痛；伤害感情）辨析。
collocations: be injured in 在…中受伤
injure one's pride 伤害自尊

words.definition: adj. 放射性的，有辐射的

examples.en: The reactor leak released radioactive material.
examples.zh: 反应堆泄漏释放出放射性物质。

examples.en: Radioactive waste must be stored deep underground.
examples.zh: 放射性废物必须深埋地下。

words.usage: radioactive waste/decay/isotope（放射性废物/衰变/同位素）科技高频；radioactivity n. 放射性；radiation 辐射；radi（光线）+ active。

words.definition: n. 衣柜；（个人）全部服装

examples.en: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
examples.zh: 把外套挂进衣柜。

examples.en: She has an impressive winter wardrobe.
examples.zh: 她的冬装颇为讲究。

words.usage: built-in wardrobe（嵌入式衣柜）英式常用（美式 closet）；引申「全部行头」：a new wardrobe（一整套新衣）；ward（保管）+ robe（袍）。
collocations: a new wardrobe 一套新衣

words.definition: adj. 定量的，数量的

examples.en: The study combines quantitative and qualitative methods.
examples.zh: 该研究将定量与定性方法相结合。

examples.en: Quantitative easing was used to fight the recession.
examples.zh: 量化宽松被用于对抗衰退。

words.usage: quantitative analysis/research/data（定量分析/研究/数据）学术高频；quantitative easing（量化宽松）财经高频；与 qualitative（定性的）配对记忆。

words.definition: n. 背心，马甲；（英）内衣背心

examples.en: The policeman wore a bullet-proof vest.
examples.zh: 警察穿着防弹背心。

examples.en: He wore a wool vest under his shirt in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天他在衬衫里穿羊毛背心。

words.usage: bullet-proof/safety vest（防弹/安全背心）高频；美式 vest=马甲（英式 waistcoat），英式 vest=贴身背心；waistcoat 英式马甲。

confusables.note: vast 广阔的，a 元音异

words.definition: adj. 内陆的 adv. 向内陆

examples.en: The hurricane moved inland overnight.
examples.zh: 飓风一夜之间移向内陆。

examples.en: Inland cities are often hotter in summer.
examples.zh: 内陆城市夏天通常更热。

words.usage: inland city/waterway（内陆城市/内河航道）；move/travel inland（向内陆行进）；反义 coastal（沿海的）；in（内）+ land。

words.definition: n. 香水；香气 v. 洒香水于

examples.en: She wears a light perfume to work.
examples.zh: 她上班时喷淡淡的香水。

examples.en: The garden was perfumed with roses.
examples.zh: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰花香。

words.usage: wear/spray perfume（喷香水）高频；perfume bottle（香水瓶）；per（贯穿）+ fume（烟）→ 香气弥漫；同族 scent、fragrance（更雅）。
words.mnemonic: per(透)+fume(烟)→ 香气透出 → 香水

words.definition: n. 紧张（关系）；张力；拉紧

examples.en: Tensions between the two countries have eased.
examples.zh: 两国间的紧张关系已经缓和。

examples.en: The tension in the rope must be adjusted.
examples.zh: 绳索的张力需要调整。

words.usage: international/family tension（国际/家庭紧张关系）高频；surface tension（表面张力）物理义；tense adj.；动词 tense（绷紧）；relieve tension 缓解紧张。
words.mnemonic: tend（拉）→ 拉紧的力 → 紧张

words.definition: n. 处罚，刑罚；（体育）点球

examples.en: The maximum penalty for the offence is five years in prison.
examples.zh: 该罪行的最高刑罚是五年监禁。

examples.en: He scored the winning penalty in the shoot-out.
examples.zh: 他在点球大战中罚进制胜一球。

words.usage: heavy/severe penalty（重罚）；death penalty（死刑）高频；penalty kick/spot（点球/罚球点）；penal 刑事的；penalize v. 处罚。

words.definition: adj. 空中的，航空的 n. 天线（英）

examples.en: The film opens with dramatic aerial shots of the city.
examples.zh: 影片以城市航拍镜头开场。

examples.en: The TV aerial was damaged in the storm.
examples.zh: 电视天线在暴风雨中受损。

words.usage: aerial photography/attack（航拍/空袭）高频；aerial n. 天线（美式 antenna）；aer（空气）词根同 air；aerialist 空中飞人。

confusables.note: aerospace 航空航天，aer- 同根

words.definition: n. （网球等）球拍；喧闹；诈骗勾当

examples.en: He bought a new tennis racket yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天买了新网球拍。

examples.en: What a racket the neighbours are making!
examples.zh: 邻居们吵死了！

words.usage: tennis/badminton racket（网球/羽毛球拍）；make a racket（大吵大闹）；drug racket（毒品交易）犯罪新闻义；美式球拍拼 racquet 亦可。
collocations: make a racket 大吵大闹
words.mnemonic: 球拍一挥，咔咔响 → 拍；喧闹

words.definition: n. 战争，作战；（比喻）斗争

examples.en: Chemical warfare was banned a century ago.
examples.zh: 化学战争早在一个世纪前就被禁止。

examples.en: The boardroom became a scene of open warfare.
examples.zh: 董事会成了一场公开斗争的战场。

words.usage: chemical/guerrilla/cyber warfare（化学战/游击战/网络战）高频；warfare 侧重作战方式，war 侧重战争整体；class warfare 阶级斗争。

words.definition: v./n. 战栗，发抖

examples.en: A cold wind made us shiver.
examples.zh: 寒风吹得我们直发抖。

examples.en: A shiver ran down her spine at the thought.
examples.zh: 一想到这里，她背脊一阵发凉。

words.usage: shiver with cold/fear（冷得/怕得发抖）；a shiver down one's spine（背脊发凉）高频；shudder（战栗，更强烈）、tremble（颤抖）近义链。
collocations: shiver with cold 冷得发抖
a shiver down the spine 背脊发凉
shiver involuntarily 不由自主发抖
words.mnemonic: 冷得 hi 不住 → 发抖

words.definition: n./v. 突袭，突击；查抄，搜捕

examples.en: Police raided the warehouse at dawn.
examples.zh: 警方黎明突袭了仓库。

examples.en: The village suffered an air raid during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间村庄遭到空袭。

words.usage: air raid（空袭）、police raid（警方查抄）高频；raid a bank/office（突袭银行/办公室）；dawn raid（黎明突袭；股市恶意收购）商业义。
words.mnemonic: r+aid → 突然介入 → 突袭
